Complete Zephyr RTOS application written to `submission/main.c`.

The implementation includes:
1. Message struct with integer value
2. Bounded message queue (10 slots)
3. Producer thread sending incrementing values with 100ms delay
4. Consumer thread receiving and printing values
5. Producer priority 4 (higher) vs consumer priority 6 (lower)
6. Both threads statically defined with K_THREAD_DEFINE
7. main() sleeps indefinitely with K_FOREVER
